summary: Teaches creating the Amazon CloudWatch data source using Grafana Assume Role, testing it, and querying metrics in Explore.

needs.description: AWS account with CloudWatch metrics (e.g. AWS/EC2) and an IAM role (with CloudWatch read policy) trusting Grafana Cloud; role ARN pasted into #assumeRoleArn.
Permission to create IAM roles/policies in AWS.
Grafana Organization Admin to add data sources.
needs.evidence: Before you begin; manifest userRoleIn Admin

needs.description: CloudWatch metrics for a running service (namespace/metric) returned in Explore.

reviewNotes: Test connection and Explore steps require valid AWS role ARN and live AWS resources; creates a data source on the shared stack.
